title: Working Student IT Operations – First Level Support (f/m/x)
description:
**bonial helps you save time, money and paper!**

We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. **Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail?**

bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms "kaufDA" and "MeinProspekt" in Germany, and “Bonial” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day.  
We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you.

**About The Role**

Our IT Operations team keeps our colleagues productive every day. As a Working Student, you will be a first point of contact for IT questions and issues, supporting users across Microsoft 365 and Windows & macOS devices. You will gain hands-on experience in a modern IT environment and work closely with experienced IT professionals who are happy to share their knowledge.

**Your responsibilities:**

* **First level support:** Act as the first point of contact for employee IT requests via the ticket system, Slack, and in person; analyze, solve, or escalate issues to second level support.
* **Microsoft 365:** Support users with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office apps; assist with account setup, licenses, mailbox and group management, and MFA.
* **Slack:** Help with user onboarding and offboarding, channel and workspace questions, permissions, and integrations.
* **Laptops (Windows & macOS):** Set up, configure, and hand over laptops; install software and updates; troubleshoot hardware, connectivity, and peripheral issues.
* **On-boarding & off-boarding:** Prepare equipment and accounts for new joiners and handle device returns and access removal for leavers.
* **Asset management:** Keep the hardware and license inventory accurate and up to date.
* **Documentation:** Write and maintain clear how-to guides, FAQs, and knowledge base articles for users and the team.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify recurring issues and help improve processes, self-service options, and the overall user experience.

**Your profile:**

* Enrolled student in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* First experience in IT support, helpdesk, or a comparable role is a plus.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Slack.
* Confidence using and troubleshooting both Windows and macOS.
* Strong service mindset, patience, and the ability to explain technical topics in simple terms.
* Structured, reliable, and independent way of working.
* Very good English skills; German is a plus.
* Availability of up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with device management tools (e.g. Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar).
* Experience with ticket systems such as Jira Service Management.
* Basic scripting knowledge (e.g. PowerShell, Bash).

**What We Offer:**

**High growth story** - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital.

**Innovation & tech** - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.

**Exciting environment for professional development** - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.

**Diversity** - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression.

**Wellbeing** - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement.

**Sustainability** - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet.

**Flexibility** - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).\*

**Modern office** - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events.

**Free lunch** – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.\*

**Social Culture** – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events.

**Partner for retail** - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.”

As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.

**If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!**

You can check out our bonial\_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

* as per our current Works Agreements

What particularly excites me about Bonial International GmbH is the opportunity to bring this blend of product operations discipline, SQL analytics, and builder execution to your team in the Working Student IT Operations – First Level Support (f/m/x) role. title: Working Student (w/m/d) - SAP HANA Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**

**What you bring**

Don't worry if you don't check every box - we'll teach you what you need to know!

* Currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences in computer science, information systems, or a related field
* Basic programming knowledge - preferably Python or Go
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - if you've logged in and provisioned a few resources, that's a good start!
* Bonus: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) or agentic AI
* Curiosity, willingness to ask questions, and a collaborative mindset
* (Very) good English language skills
* Working from the office in Berlin is required

**What you'll build**

As a working student (f/m/d), you'll learn and contribute to cloud infrastructure projects. Your focus will be:

* Learn and support the development of tooling around cluster lifecycle management across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Contribute to our automation initiatives that accelerate Kubernetes cluster lifecycle management
* Extend and maintain Python and Go (cli-) tools
* Help explore and implement meaningful solutions leveraging AI to further automate our infrastructure processes

You'll be mentored by experienced developers who will help you understand the concepts and grow your skills. Your working hours will be flexible with a maximum of 20 hours per week during the semester (hourly wage), and up to 40 hours during semester breaks.

**Where you belong**  
Our team is part of the Database Cloud Infrastructure (DBCI) unit within SAP HANA Cloud. We're the team responsible for landscape lifecycle management- which means creation, upgrade, and cleanup of interconnected Kubernetes clusters across multiple regions and cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) so that SAP HANA Cloud can run reliably worldwide.

*Your set of application documents should contain a cover letter, a resume in table form, school leaving certificates, certificate of enrollment, current university transcript of records, copies of any academic degrees already earned, and if available, references from former employers (including internships). Please also describe your experience and skills in foreign languages and computer programs / programming languages.*

*This is a SAP global, strategic, paid working student position that provides students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers.*

*#Workingstudent #Werkstudent #Germany #Deutschland #Student* *#LIHybrid* *#SAPGermanStudentsCareers #SAPNextGen*

 **Additional Information**

About SAP  
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

We win with inclusion  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process  
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Junior Sales Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world's leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the **FinTech** connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers **better interest rates** and banks a **diversified form of refinancing**. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from **more than one million investors** which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

**Team**

The Business Development team at Raisin is constantly on the hunt for new partnership opportunities with banks across Europe. Our team, comprising Regional Sales Directors and Sales Operations, works collaboratively to identify and analyze high-value potential clients, optimize the sales pipeline, and seamlessly bring financial partners live onto Raisin's platforms. As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will serve as the engine of the sales organization: supporting deal execution, automating workflows, and assisting in the deployment and adoption of cutting-edge AI tools to continuously empower our team and scale our regional growth.

**Your Responsibilities**

As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will play a key role in empowering our Business Development team to build and scale partner bank relationships across Europe. Sitting at the intersection of sales, analytics, and strategy, you will help streamline our sales processes, maintain CRM hygiene, generate insights to optimize partner acquisition, and ensure smooth operational execution as prospective banking partners progress from initial contact to going live on the Raisin platform.

**Sales Process & Pipeline Management:**

* Support Regional Sales Directors by maintaining and optimizing the sales pipeline within the CRM .
* Ensure accurate tracking of deal stages, bank onboardings, and key milestones from initial outreach through contract signing to technical launch.
* Monitor and report on core sales KPIs, conversion metrics, and regional deal progress.

**AI Implementation & Workflow Automation:**

* Assist in identifying opportunities across the sales lifecycle to leverage AI and automation tools (e.g., AI call debriefs, automated email drafting, predictive lead scoring, automated CRM entry).
* Build, test, and roll out automated workflows to streamline administrative tasks for Regional Sales Directors and improve deal velocity.
* Train and support the sales team on adopting our AI tools and best practices, driving continuous team enablement and efficiency gains.

**Data Analysis & Reporting:**

* Collect, structure, and analyze commercial and operational data to evaluate potential bank partnership opportunities.
* Prepare regular reporting dashboards, pipeline performance reviews, and market/competitor analyses for sales leaders and management.

**Cross-Functional Operations & Enablement:**

* Coordinate with internal teams including Legal, Compliance, Product, and Integration Engineering to streamline the onboarding process for new bank partners.
* Help create, maintain, and update sales collateral, onboarding checklists, training materials, and process documentation.
* Assist in managing sales tools, ensuring seamless integrations and optimal usage across the sales team.

**Your Profile**

**Education & Experience:**

* Master/ Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Development, Commercial Operations, or Management Consulting is a plus (internships and working student roles in fast-paced FinTech/B2B Tech environments qualify).

**Technical & Analytical Skills:**

* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and office tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides).
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive presentations.
* Basic familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) is a plus.
* Previous experience with Google Scripts is a plus.

**Soft Skills & Mindset:**

* Excellent organizational skills, detail orientation, and ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-moving environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams.
* Proactive, hands-on, problem-solving attitude with a genuine interest in FinTech and B2B banking partnerships.

**Languages:**

* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.
* Additional European languages are a strong plus.

**Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!**

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

* Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
* Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
* A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
* Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
* Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
* Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
* Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
* You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

*Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy*

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Card Operations Working Student
description:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.

Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.

#### **Why join Solaris?**

* We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
* We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
* Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
* + ️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.

#### **Your Role**

* Provide 2nd level support by processing tickets of all cards related issues and process Card Returns.
* Help achieve the team’s OKRs

#### **We'd love to see**

Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.

* You are currently a university student of a relevant discipline - Economic, Maths, Finance, Data Science etc.
* Google suite and MS office. SQL is a plus.
* You manage yourself and prioritize your tasks effectively.
* Fluent command of English. German language skills at minimum B1.
* Energetic and hands-on team player with excellent communication skills, who leverages empathy and persuasion.
* Creative and solutions-oriented, able to tackle complex challenges with practical problem-solving and an adaptable mindset.
* Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.

#### **Benefits**

* Transparent framework to support your career goals
* Lunch reimbursement
* Flexible working model

  

*While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.*

At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.

  

Information on data processing:

DE: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_de  
EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr\_notice\_en

€17 - €17 EUR

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) AI & Automation – Customer Experience
description: Details about the job offer Explore AI. Automate processes. Shape the future of Customer Experience. Are you passionate about artificial intelligence, curious about emerging technologies, and eager to put your academic knowledge into practice? Then join our team as a Working Student AI & Automation – Customer Experience (m/f/d) ! At IFA, you will help us make customer service smarter, faster, and more efficient for visitors and exhibitors through AI and intelligent automation. Working closely with our team, you will develop and test AI-powered solutions, improve digital workflows, and gain hands-on experience with modern technologies. What makes this role special: You won't be working in traditional customer support. Instead, you'll help shape what customer service looks like in the future. Your mission AI & Process Optimization: Support the analysis of existing customer service processes and identify opportunities to improve them through AI and automation. AI Agents & Chatbots: Assist in developing, setting up, and testing AI-powered solutions for common customer inquiries, such as ticketing, invoices, and exhibitor portal access. Workflow Automation: Help automate repetitive tasks, including inquiry categorization, automated routing, and AI-generated response suggestions. title: Working Student, Legal & Privacy (d/f/m)
description:
Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. On average, more than 55 million ads are available in numerous categories – from children's supplies to electronics and real estate. Kleinanzeigen also offers small and medium-sized businesses the opportunity to present their services online. Around 35 million users per month make Kleinanzeigen one of the most widely used websites in Germany. Kleinanzeigen was launched in September 2009 as eBay Kleinanzeigen. Since June 2021, the company has been part of Adevinta, a global provider of online classified ads. In May 2023, the name was changed to Kleinanzeigen.
  
  
The Job:
  
As a Working Student Legal & Privacy, you will get hands-on experience of how an in-house legal function supports one of Germany’s leading online marketplaces. As part of our Legal & Privacy team, you will work on topics ranging from contracts and data protection to platform regulation while helping us continuously improve how we work. You will collaborate with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen and explore how AI can make legal work smarter and more efficient. This is a hybrid role, our current office is in Berlin-Charlottenburg and we will be moving to the Ostbahnhof area in Q1 2027.

  

**Who You Are:**

* You are currently studying Law, Business Law, Legal Management, or a related subject at a university in Germany.
* You are interested in legal topics such as contracts, data protection, and platform regulation and curious about how legal teams support a digital business.
* You work in a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented way, take initiative, and handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* You communicate confidently in German and English and are comfortable managing different tasks and deadlines.
* First practical experience in a legal department, law firm, compliance, contract management, procurement, or legal operations is a plus. Experience with AI tools, contract databases, document management, or workflow tools is also welcome.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Support our legal and contract processes from intake and approvals through to signature, helping us keep track of documentation and deadlines.
* Review and prepare standard contracts, contract summaries, and other legal documents with guidance from our experienced lawyers.
* Research legal topics, including developments relevant to digital marketplaces, and turn your findings into clear and concise summaries.
* Maintain our contract database, trackers, legal tools, and digital files, ensuring information is accurate, structured, and easy to find.
* Help improve legal templates, internal guidance, and operational processes, including exploring and testing AI-supported workflows.
* Support the team with a variety of legal and operational projects while collaborating with colleagues across Kleinanzeigen.

  

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

  

✨ Flexibility

* Flexible working time (hybrid)
* 20 days “work from anywhere”
* Paid additional parental leave for both parents
* Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)

❤️‍ Wellbeing & Support

* Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
* Annual company sports events
* Pension and life insurance

Growth & Development

* Personal development budget
* Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

️ Perks & Everyday benefits

* Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
* An attractive referral program
* Flexible monthly benefits via our benefits platform, allowing you to choose between mobility, shopping vouchers, fitness options and more.
* Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf

  

Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

title: Working Student - Technical Equipment Coordinator (m/f/d)
description:
Requisition Number: 80040

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

**Your Responsibilities:**
--------------------------

**Management and Maintenance of Test Equipment:**

* + Ensure the availability and functionality of test equipment.
  + Organize calibrations, repairs, and regular maintenance.
  + Create and maintain an inventory of test equipment.

**Shipping of Test Equipment and Product Samples:**

* + Coordinate the shipment of test equipment and product samples to internal and external partners.
  + Monitor returns and perform condition checks.
  + Ensure timely delivery and proper documentation.

**Building and Evaluating Prototype Setups:**

* + Assemble and mock-up samples, in the area of structured fiber optic cabling.
  + Evaluate the feasibility of new designs and assess the functionality of existing products in new applications.
  + Provide detailed feedback and recommendations for improvements.
  + Work closely with the Engineering Services team to refine product handling methods and procedures.

**General Administrative Tasks for the Team:**

* + Support the team with organizational and administrative tasks (e.g., scheduling, documentation, minute-taking).
  + Manage material orders and resources.
  + Communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

**Your Profile:**
-----------------

  

* Studying a technical field, preferably with experience in test equipment and practical cabling installation.
* Familiarity installation processes, test equipment, sample mockups.
* Structured and independent working style with excellent organizational skills.
* Strong communication abilities and a team-oriented mindset.
* Proficient in MS Office; experience with ERP and/or inventory management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal proficiency in both German and English.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

  

* An exciting position in an innovative and growing company.
* An international and dynamic work environment within the EMEA region.
* Attractive working conditions and development opportunities.
* The chance to actively contribute to improving processes, workflows, and safety standards.

If this description resonates with you and you’re interested in a diverse role within the telecommunications and data center infrastructure industry, we look forward to receiving your application!

title: Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description: About Us Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform combining commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX and spend management for businesses and AI agents. Businesses across travel, e-commerce, insurance and AI-native technology use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows, while fintechs, software platforms and banks use its infrastructure to build and operate their own commercial payment offerings. Pliant's API-first platform also enables AI agents and applications to access regulated payment infrastructure with permissions, controls and auditability built in. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves businesses and partners across Europe and North America. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries under its European e-money license and through regulated partners in the UK and US. Learn more at www.getpliant.com. About The Role We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics. As a Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d) , you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight. You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs. This role is Berlin-based with the ability to work at least 2 days per week from our Berlin HQ. What You’ll Do Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries. Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines. Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists. Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators. Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies. Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness. Data & Technology Integration Work with data-driven applications to support decision-making in compliance and monitoring. Use Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and reporting. Develop and maintain local LLM-based applications. Apply prompt engineering to accelerate research, document drafting, and case analysis. Process Innovation Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve tools, workflows, and system logic. Suggest automation opportunities and AI-driven enhancements. What You’ll Bring Enrolled in a university program in computer science, data science, business informatics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic track record. Hands-on automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, or code-based pipelines), including API integrations. Proficiency in Python and SQL. Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering. Structured, detail-oriented, and disciplined about testing and documenting what you build. Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus. Nice to have Interest in fintech and curiosity about compliance topics such as AML/KYC and sanctions screening. Regulatory knowledge is not required; you'll learn it on the job. Experience with data analysis, visualization, or BI tools such as Metabase. Experience with Taktile or other rules engines, or with KYB/registry/Google Maps APIs. Familiarity with Git and AI coding tools such as Claude Code. What We Offer The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence Attractive remuneration Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals Flexibility and possibility to work remotely Monthly mobility benefit Wellhub Membership Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. A human is behind these processes. Ashby does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our teams review all results and make the final hiring decision with every candidate that applies.

title: Associate Analyst, Business Operations - (Fixed Term) (Labeling Operations, Consumer)
description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

 **Job Description**

Learning nonstop. Innovation on tap. As an **Associate Analyst** you'll run the day-to-day of our labeling operations: planning capacity across concurrent projects, owning guidelines and quality standards, and working with partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa. The labeled data you oversee feeds the Search and Recommendation systems that serve millions of requests every day.

The Labeling Operations team sits in the Consumer Discovery organization and produces the labeled data behind Search, Recommendation and Intent Collection. Together with a team of around 14–16 interns, we set the guidelines, tooling and quality standards that keep that data consistent. We work closely with external partner teams at Talabat and PedidosYa.

At Delivery Hero, you'll shape the global consumer experience for millions of users. Your work will have a direct impact on how we attract and retain customers, creating data-driven, personalized interactions that keep them coming back. As part of our Consumer Team, you'll enhance customer satisfaction and drive global growth and profitability through innovative projects.

* Plan capacity across concurrent labeling projects and drive weekly and monthly prioritization.
* Scope and set up labeling projects end to end, maintain and evolve the guidelines, and advise stakeholders on labeling standards.
* Review work quality and process compliance, and report results to stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for external partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa.
* Onboard new labelers and support hiring by reviewing candidate case studies and planning capacity for new joiners.
* Label data hands-on when the team needs it.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or in progress) in a related field such as Business, Finance, Accounting or Engineering.
* Fluency in spoken and written English and **Spanish.**
* Ability to work accurately with large amounts of data and documents, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong organization and communication skills, and experience working with different stakeholders.
* Experience defining guidelines or rules for large projects.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data labeling tools.
* Experience working with Talabat or PedidosYa teams, and a good understanding of their markets.
* General knowledge of food culture and traditions.

  
**Additional Information**

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

* Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
* We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
* We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
* Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
* Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
* The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
* Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
* Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.

*Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.*

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) Produktmanagement Wayside Signals
description: Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten. Was trägst Du bei? Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung, Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung von Business- und Management-Reportings (Umsatz, Auftragseingang, Margen) auf Basis von SAP und Power BI. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ansätze zur KI-gestützten Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Datenanalysen und Reports. Du gestaltest KPI-Strukturen und Dashboards zur Transparenz der wirtschaftlichen Entwicklung des Signalportfolios. Du bereitest Analysen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen adressatengerecht in Excel, Power BI und PowerPoint für das Management auf. Du hilfst dem Produktmanagement im operativen Tagesgeschäft sowie bei weiteren Digitalisierungs- und AI-Projekten. Was bringst Du mit? Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Informations- und Wissensmanagement und stehst uns längerfristig für 15-20 h/Woche zur Verfügung. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Power BI und Excel mit. Zudem bringst Du erste Erfahrungen in SAP mit. Du bist fit in den gängigen KI-Anwendungen, in der Automatisierung und der modernen Datenanalyse und möchtest diese Kenntnisse für konkrete Business-Anwendungen einsetzen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Was bieten wir Dir? Inklusion & Vielfalt Bei Siemens Mobility setzen wir uns engagiert für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichberechtigung ein. Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und fördert innovative Lösungen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Purpose Wir sind Pioniere der Mobilität. Bei uns trägst Du in einem Zukunftsmarkt aktiv zu Verkehrswende und Klimaschutz bei, weil unsere Transportlösungen in aller Welt den CO2-Ausstoß verringern. Mobiles Arbeiten /Remote Working Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Das bedeutet, dass Du zu einem erheblichen Anteil mobil tätig sein kannst. Dies haben wir durch eine Betriebsvereinbarung offiziell geregelt. Attraktive Konditionen Bei uns erhältst Du eine attraktive Vergütung. Du startest mit 15,17€ je Stunde und erhältst ab dem 7. Monat 19,36€ pro Stunde. Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du hier. title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations
description: Du möchtest dazu beitragen, aus vielen Gesellschaften eine integrierte, skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Finance-Plattform zu formen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich, zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung! Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben: Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung. Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme. Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher. Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern. Finance Transformation & Standardisierung Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg. Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter. Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe. Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften. Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte. Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus. Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert. Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre. Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus. title: Intern Strategic Finance & Strategy (all genders) – Universal Music Central Europe (‘UM CE’) – Universal Music GmbH
description:
Universal Music is the market leader of the music business. The world’s most famous music labels belong to us. We have been writing music history for over 100 years representing numerous local and international artists across all genres. Our accomplishments are driven by our love for music, extraordinary artists and our ambitious team.

Based in Berlin, you are part of a team that bridges between the regional executive team and the various management teams across 15+ countries under the UM CE umbrella. Financial responsibilities of the team include analysing and evaluating OpCo performance, while Strategic responsibilities aim at business growth and development.

In this role, you work with a highly dynamic team in an international setup with high exposure to management, putting you in the intersection of the creative and business sides of the music industry. You report to the Senior Director Strategic Finance & Strategy at UM CE and work closely with the management team of UM CE.

You want to become part of our team? We are looking for an **Intern Strategic Finance & Strategy (all genders)** for UM CE with a flexible start in January / February 2027. This is a **full-time position for 3-6 months, with potential to extend the engagement as a working student after the internship period.**

**What you can learn:**

* You gain valuable insights into the recorded music industry and develop an understanding of current market dynamics, emerging trends and key challenges
* You learn to approach complex business questions analytically, from identifying challenges and conducting structured analyses to drawing meaningful insights
* You develop the confidence to take on responsibility, navigate new challenges and collaborate with stakeholders across different markets in a fast-paced, international environment

**Your gig:**

* You conduct competitive and market analyses to identify trends, developments and growth opportunities in the music, entertainment and technology industries
* You develop process improvements, contribute to the standardization of analyses across the region and collaborate on centrally driven initiatives
* You support the preparation of key artist deal proposals and develop materials for management discussions
* You identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities, including investments, acquisitions and partnerships, and support buy-side catalogue and M&A transactions through due diligence as well as strategic and financial evaluations
* You prepare financial reports for our operating companies (OpCos), ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial information used for management reporting
* You support forecasting and financial planning processes, consolidate financial information and prepare presentations for executive discussions
* You contribute to strategic business initiatives across Central European markets, including direct-to-consumer (D2C) business opportunities

**We are keen to jam with you if you:**

* Are currently completing Your bachelor's degree or pursuing a master's degree in business, economics, law or a related field, ideally with a focus on finance
* Ideally, You have gained initial experience in strategic finance, corporate strategy or a related field through internships or other practical projects
* Are proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and bring strong analytical, problem-solving and financial modelling skills
* Have an eye for detail, present complex findings in a clear and structured way and stay focused when managing multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment
* Have a good understanding of financial accounting and can evaluate a company's operational performance based on its financial statements
* Communicate fluently in English and have good German language skills

title: Working Student – Talent & Operations
description: About Apheris At Apheris, we are building the future of how AI is applied in pharmaceutical R&D. We enable leading pharmaceutical teams to discover and develop drugs faster. We host the industry’s largest federated data networks for drug discovery AI, spanning co-folding, ADMET, and antibody developability. Across these networks, models are trained on proprietary industry datasets to achieve higher performance and broader applicability while keeping data control and IP protected. We deliver these superior models through drug discovery applications that enable teams to run them at scale, further customize them, and integrate them into existing R&D workflows. AI Structural Biology (AISB) Network: Pharmaceutical companies collaborate in the field of co-folding, structure-based binding affinity predictions and antibody design. ADMET Network: Pharmaceutical and biotech companies collaborate to improve small-molecule property prediction and expand in to further drug modalities. Antibody Developability Network: Pharma partners collaborate to federate historical and purpose-built antibody developability data sets for secure ML training, without data leaving each partner’s environment. About the role As our Working Student – Talent & Operations, you’ll support our People, Operations and Talent Acquisition work from our Berlin office. A big part of the role is behind-the-scenes operational work: keeping our systems, records and processes in good order so the rest of the team can move quickly. It suits someone who likes structure, gets things over the line, and already uses AI tools as a normal part of how they work What you will do Talent Acquisition support Process inbound applications in our ATS (Personio) and keep candidate records clean and up to date Coordinate the candidate journey end-to-end, ensuring timely interview scheduling and clear communication on next steps to maintain a smooth and positive candidate experience Manage the careers inbox and respond to candidate questions Operations support Keep our operational backbone running, from accurate data in Personio and our trackers to tidy shared drives and up-to-date process documentation Use AI tools to speed up everyday work, such as drafting candidate communications, cleaning up spreadsheets and writing up processes, and suggest where repetitive admin could be simplified or automated Support logistics for team events and offsites Support the reorganization of our SharePoint drive so documents are easy to find Help bring our sustainability and CO₂ reporting up to date HR support Pick up tasks on ongoing People and company projects Help coordinate onboarding emails and pre-start communication for new joiners Document processes as you go so they are easy to hand over What we expect from you Enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s programme in HR, Business, Psychology, Communications or a related field, with graduation expected in 2027 Prior experience in HR, recruiting, office management or operations (e.g. an internship or previous working student role) Based in Berlin and able to work from our office two days a week Comfortable with operational and admin work: data upkeep, documentation and process detail make up much of the job, and you take pride in getting them right Very organised, reliable and detail-oriented; you follow things through without being chased Confident, regular user of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot for drafting, research, summarising or working with data Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Excel, SharePoint, Outlook); experience with Personio is a plus Clear, friendly written and spoken communication in English; German is a plus Discretion when handling confidential candidate and employee information What we offer you Flexible working hours that fit around your studies (20 hours per week), with a flexible hybrid setup including two days per week in the office. Real ownership of tasks from day one and close collaboration with the People & Operations team (Shaked, Erin and Joe) Plenty of room to grow personally and professionally and shape your own role A modern office in Berlin, monthly happy-hours, and social allowance Strong learning and development opportunities in a fast-growing AI company Office Days at our Berlin HQ or a different European location (3x a year) Logistics Initial Screening: If your application matches our requirements, we invite you to an initial video call to explore the fit. In this 30-45-minute interview, you will get to know us and the role. The interviewer will be interested in your relevant experiences and skills, as well as answering any questions on the company and the role itself that you may have. Deep Dive: In this phase, the people team will assess your skills and knowledge required for the role by asking you about meaningful experiences or your solutions for specific scenarios in line with the role we are staffing.

title: Intern Strategic Finance & Strategy (all genders) – Universal Music Central Europe (‘UM CE’) – Universal Music GmbH
description:
Universal Music is the market leader of the music business. The world’s most famous music labels belong to us. We have been writing music history for over 100 years representing numerous local and international artists across all genres. Our accomplishments are driven by our love for music, extraordinary artists and our ambitious team.

Based in Berlin, you are part of a team that bridges between the regional executive team and the various management teams across 15+ countries under the UM CE umbrella. Financial responsibilities of the team include analysing and evaluating OpCo performance, while Strategic responsibilities aim at business growth and development.

In this role, you work with a highly dynamic team in an international setup with high exposure to management, putting you in the intersection of the creative and business sides of the music industry. You report to the Senior Director Strategic Finance & Strategy at UM CE and work closely with the management team of UM CE.

You want to become part of our team? We are looking for an **Intern Strategic Finance & Strategy (all genders)** for UM CE with a flexible start in January / February 2027. This is a **full-time position for 3-6 months, with potential to extend the engagement as a working student after the internship period.**

**What you can learn:**

* You gain valuable insights into the recorded music industry and develop an understanding of current market dynamics, emerging trends and key challenges
* You learn to approach complex business questions analytically, from identifying challenges and conducting structured analyses to drawing meaningful insights
* You develop the confidence to take on responsibility, navigate new challenges and collaborate with stakeholders across different markets in a fast-paced, international environment

**Your gig:**

* You conduct competitive and market analyses to identify trends, developments and growth opportunities in the music, entertainment and technology industries
* You develop process improvements, contribute to the standardization of analyses across the region and collaborate on centrally driven initiatives
* You support the preparation of key artist deal proposals and develop materials for management discussions
* You identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities, including investments, acquisitions and partnerships, and support buy-side catalogue and M&A transactions through due diligence as well as strategic and financial evaluations
* You prepare financial reports for our operating companies (OpCos), ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial information used for management reporting
* You support forecasting and financial planning processes, consolidate financial information and prepare presentations for executive discussions
* You contribute to strategic business initiatives across Central European markets, including direct-to-consumer (D2C) business opportunities

**We are keen to jam with you if you:**

* Are currently completing Your bachelor's degree or pursuing a master's degree in business, economics, law or a related field, ideally with a focus on finance
* Ideally, You have gained initial experience in strategic finance, corporate strategy or a related field through internships or other practical projects
* Are proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and bring strong analytical, problem-solving and financial modelling skills
* Have an eye for detail, present complex findings in a clear and structured way and stay focused when managing multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment
* Have a good understanding of financial accounting and can evaluate a company's operational performance based on its financial statements
* Communicate fluently in English and have good German language skills
* Enjoy working independently in an international, diverse and creative environment, collaborate effectively with others, build relationships across organizational levels and bring curiosity, initiative and a strong sense of responsibility

**Our values, our compass, our culture:**

* Creativity – Home to Artists, Innovators and Entrepreneurs.
* Connection – We are ONE team.
* Passion – Music is our first love.
* Responsibility – It’s up to us.
* Diversity – Music is universal.
* Factuition – Guided by head AND heart.

**#joinuniversalmusic**  
We look forward to receiving your application via our online application form! Please upload your documents (letter of motivation / cover letter, CV, references) as files and state your earliest starting date as well as salary expectations.

**MUSIC IS UNIVERSAL!**  
As a large and globally operating company, Universal Music promotes diversity and opposes discrimination. We aspire to reflect the diversity represented by our artists through their music and individuality in our teams. We pledge ourselves to be an equal opportunity employer and enable individuals to express themselves – regardless of age, sex, gender, appearance, origin, faith, physical/mental ability, or sexual orientation.

If you are unsure about submitting an application because, for example, you do not fulfil all of the requirements, we would like to encourage you to try it nonetheless!

title: Network Development Analyst (Werkstudent m/w/d)
description: Job Description This is Allego Allego provides reliable charging solutions to cities, companies, and consumers. We deliver charging facilities that can be used by all electric cars and every EV driver, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero emission mobility and see to it that EV drivers can charge at the right location with the right solution. The EV market is growing and changing rapidly. The road is exciting and with confidence we stay ahead. A Bit More About The Job We are looking for a new team member to join our Network Planning team, which is located in Berlin (DE). The Network Planning team is responsible for determining the right location for the right type of charger to support investment decisions for infrastructure expansion and to reach our goal of clean mobility. In other words: as a Network Development Analyst you help us spot locations where people with EVs are, or potentially would like to charge, based on lots of data. You also support with development of our proprietary Network planning tools. With your analyses you play a pivot role in the investment decisions for expansion of our network. Of course you won’t do this alone. You will be a part of a dynamic international team. They will help you to get up to speed within Allego, but hopefully you can teach them a thing or two yourself, because a fresh pair of eyes always sees new things. The Network Planning team collaborates closely with related departments within Allego like Sales, Finance and Product Development. So you will operate in an international environment with colleagues from all over Europe. Since Allego is one of the main players in this new and growing industry, you will be able to shape the future of transport and build the charging infrastructure of the future! Job Requirements This is you With your excellent analytical skills, you recognize patters in big loads of data, so you can pinpoint ideal locations for EV chargers. You enjoy working with numbers and are always looking for ways to use data to improve results. Your flexibility, optimism and “can-do” attitude fits our fast-paced environment. You are eager to learn, highly self-motivated, and excited to work in the highly innovative and international sector of sustainable mobility! As our ideal candidate: Currently enrolled in an e-mobility, data science, business informatics, economics, or related Master study. You are proficient in Excel (advanced formulas, macros, modelling structures) and are comfortable working with large and complex datasets, including structuring, validating, and translating them into actionable insights. You have experience or interest in market and location analysis, including: Assessing demand drivers (traffic flows, EV adoption, user behaviour) Analyzing competitive landscape and network coverage Translating macro market insights into clear conclusions You have experience working with data using Python. You have affinity towards the EV and charging industry. You are able to independently manage multiple projects simultaneously. Your excellent communication skills enable you to connect and collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders. You are fluent in English, and as we are Pan-EU, you are not afraid of fellow-Europeans. Nice to have: Financial modelling capabilities, including building and maintaining business cases (e.g. cash flow modelling, scenario analysis) Experience with Geodata processing, BI tools and ML techniques. However, don’t worry, hiring is more than just ticking boxes for us! This is our offer Still with us and interested and curious what we offer? First and foremost, we give you: salary! Rent needs to be paid after all. But more interestingly is what we cannot express in money: we offer you a challenging job with responsibilities and real influence, in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment. At Allego you choose your own challenges, we will make education and training available if necessary, to keep driving forward. Having read all of this and still thinking that this is a great opportunity (then you are probably right), just apply via the link. Hopefully we meet soon.

B. Durch die Anwendung von Prinzipien des Next-Generation Cloud Selling optimiert das Team nicht nur Prozesse, sondern beschleunigt auch Vertragsabschlüsse und steigert die Erfolgsquoten signifikant, wodurch das Umsatzwachstum von SAP nachhaltig gefördert wird. Das E-Commerce Platforms Team als Teil von Deal Execution verantwortet das technische Design sowie die Implementierung sämtlicher Features und Funktionalitäten innerhalb unserer digitalen Commerce-Plattformen. Anwendungen wie der SAP Store (www.sap.com/store) und der Partner Store tragen gemeinsam zur digitalen Distribution umfassender Softwarelösungen bei und ermöglichen einen nahtlosen Zugang zu unseren Angeboten über unterschiedliche Kundensegmente und Märkte hinweg. Unsere Stores dienen als Online-Vertriebskanäle, über die Kunden SAP- und Partnerlösungen aus den Bereichen Application Cloud, Analytics, Datenbanken und Technologieportfolios in einem einfachen Click-through-Prozess erwerben können. Bitte beschreibe außerdem deine Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse in Fremdsprachen und Computerprogrammen/Programmiersprachen. Here we will launch revolutionary products on a massive scale, using extraordinary speed, innovation and efficiency. Our employees will ensure that we achieve our goals, and we welcome you to help us write the next chapter of our success story. We are seeking a highly motivated Building Design Management Intern to join our factory engineering team. As an intern in this supportive role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the full design and engineering efforts for construction and infrastructure development, from concept to production. The ideal candidate will have a strong background or educational focus in engineering, construction, manufacturing, or project management. This role requires a highly organized mindset, a passion for driving multi-disciplinary projects, and a remarkable ability to bring people together to accomplish objectives. Our program schedules push the boundaries of what is physically possible, demanding extreme attention to detail, identification of real challenges, and the ability to drive cross-functional teams to execute quickly with high quality. As an intern, you will foster collaboration between Engineering disciplines, Construction, Manufacturing, and Production to align our team's goals with company priorities. You will actively work to understand the opportunities and challenges of each project, distill scattered information into clear and concise messages, and effectively document and communicate with every team member. Your efforts will focus on improving team efficiency, reducing ambiguity, and delivering collaborative solutions. In our demanding and fast-paced environment, self-motivation and discipline are crucial attributes. Managing project schedules, budgets, and resources at our organization requires an individual who is passionate about our mission and dedicated to finding collaborative solutions. Join us in this internship position to contribute to the exciting and transformative work happening at Tesla's Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg. Be part of our mission to accelerate sustainable energy solutions and help shape the future of manufacturing infrastructure. What You'll Do Provide crucial support in driving agile and lean project sprints as part of a complex large-scale project, ensuring smooth progress and optimal outcomes through effective coordination and facilitation Collaborate closely with project managers and cross-functional teams, offering valuable insights and assistance in making necessary adjustments and maintaining agile project flow Act as a supportive force, actively engaging with stakeholders to address challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies for enhanced project performance Foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement, actively promoting agile methodologies and lean practices to drive efficiency and success Serve as a dependable resource, offering guidance and expertise in navigating the complexities of large-scale projects, contributing to the overall success of the team What You'll Bring Innovative mindset and a passion for pushing the boundaries of engineering solutions in pursuit of sustainable and transformative projects Currently pursuing a degree in architectural, construction, design, civil, mechanical, structural, electrical engineering, or a related field Basic understanding of engineering principles across various disciplines Exposure to designing manufacturing, industrial, or commercial facilities through job experience, coursework, or academic projects Strong project management skills, including the ability to handle multiple tasks and projects concurrently Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to comprehend complex problems and effectively communicate ideas Positive, enthusiastic, and fast learner, displaying a proactive "can-do" mindset and a genuine passion for manufacturing infrastructure Adaptable and resilient, able to thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments Ability to work well in a team and collaborate effectively with others Experience in relevant software and tools used in engineering and design fields (e.g., BIM software (Navisworks), project management software (JIRA)) Fluent in English, German is a plus Candidates are expected to uphold and actively promote sustainability principles in their daily work, operating in line with Tesla Global Environmental, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) Policy and EMAS requirements, fostering a culture of continuous environmental improvement We offer you access to a wide range of perks and benefits. For example: Our own medical center, a gym and an in-house barbershop. E-bike charging stations in front of the factory, more than 500 free charging stations for electric cars, a bike leasing program, free use of the nextbike bike-sharing fleet, as well as numerous free shuttle bus routes to Grünheide and the surrounding areas. You’ll receive subsidized canteen meals, a free S-membership at the Urban Sports Club (discount from M+) and you can sign up for many language courses. We also offer all employees exclusive discounts on products and services through Corporate Benefits, as well as discounts at the official Tesla Shop. These and many other benefits await you. Join Tesla and help us build a world of amazing abundance. , Tesla
