title: Associate Venture Development – Commercial Product Energy (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Du willst Produkte nicht nur konzipieren, sondern sie selbst live bringen? Im Commercial Product Team von Omniwatt entwickeln wir unsere Energieprodukte, von klassischen und dynamischen Stromtarifen bis zu unserem Virtual Power Plant. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du eigene Produkte und bringst sie von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Launch. Dabei arbeitest du in einem kleinen, motivierten Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Du erkennst, wo die nächsten Produktchancen liegen, analysierst Markt und Wettbewerb und bewertest, welche Use Cases das größte Potenzial haben. Du gestaltest Produkte und Preismodelle, die unsere Kunden begeistern und unser Geschäft nachhaltig wachsen lassen, von den Specs bis zum Go-to-Market und immer mit Blick auf die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen. Du bringst neue Produkte schnell und sauber live, trackst ihre Performance und machst sie datenbasiert immer besser. Du ownst die Umsetzung unserer Product Roadmap, bringst Tech, Operations, Growth und Finance an einen Tisch und triffst Entscheidungen selbst, bei größeren Weichenstellungen gemeinsam mit Senior Stakeholdern. Du findest eigenständig Wege, unsere Prozesse mit Agentic AI, Automatisierung und datengetriebenen Analysen smarter und skalierbarer zu machen. Dein Profil Du bringst 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit, z. B. aus Strategy, Consulting, Produktmanagement, der Energiewirtschaft oder einem Startup. Du hast an einer führenden Universität oder Business School studiert, mit Business- oder MINT-Hintergrund. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Commercial Mindset und ein gutes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und Markttrends. Du denkst strukturiert, bereitest komplexe Themen klar auf und kommst schnell von der Idee in die Umsetzung. Du begeisterst dich für die Energiewende und neue Geschäftsmodelle im Strom- und Flexibilitätsmarkt. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft oder Gründungserfahrung sind ein Plus. KI-Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du nutzt sie täglich für Analysen, Konzepte und Präsentationen und arbeitest gern mit Daten-Tools wie Snowflake oder Airtable. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch, idealerweise auch auf Deutsch. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-Start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System (m/f/d)
description:
**DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System**

Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for a **DevOps Engineer** who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it.

**What you'll do**

* Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates.
* Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks.
* Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware.
* Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms.
* Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS).
* Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site.

**You are**

* 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles.
* Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell.
* Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls.
* Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.
* Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again.

**Nice to have**

* Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom).
* AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management.
* NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA.
* Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...).
* Kubernetes in production.
* Video, camera or ML inference workloads.

**Why this role matters**

You'll keep our systems running smoothly and help the team ship with confidence. And if you're curious about ML, you'll get real exposure to production AI systems.

#LI-SP1 #LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

title: Junior Sales Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world's leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the **FinTech** connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers **better interest rates** and banks a **diversified form of refinancing**. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from **more than one million investors** which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

**Team**

The Business Development team at Raisin is constantly on the hunt for new partnership opportunities with banks across Europe. Our team, comprising Regional Sales Directors and Sales Operations, works collaboratively to identify and analyze high-value potential clients, optimize the sales pipeline, and seamlessly bring financial partners live onto Raisin's platforms. As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will serve as the engine of the sales organization: supporting deal execution, automating workflows, and assisting in the deployment and adoption of cutting-edge AI tools to continuously empower our team and scale our regional growth.

**Your Responsibilities**

As a Junior Sales Operations Manager, you will play a key role in empowering our Business Development team to build and scale partner bank relationships across Europe. Sitting at the intersection of sales, analytics, and strategy, you will help streamline our sales processes, maintain CRM hygiene, generate insights to optimize partner acquisition, and ensure smooth operational execution as prospective banking partners progress from initial contact to going live on the Raisin platform.

**Sales Process & Pipeline Management:**

* Support Regional Sales Directors by maintaining and optimizing the sales pipeline within the CRM .
* Ensure accurate tracking of deal stages, bank onboardings, and key milestones from initial outreach through contract signing to technical launch.
* Monitor and report on core sales KPIs, conversion metrics, and regional deal progress.

**AI Implementation & Workflow Automation:**

* Assist in identifying opportunities across the sales lifecycle to leverage AI and automation tools (e.g., AI call debriefs, automated email drafting, predictive lead scoring, automated CRM entry).
* Build, test, and roll out automated workflows to streamline administrative tasks for Regional Sales Directors and improve deal velocity.
* Train and support the sales team on adopting our AI tools and best practices, driving continuous team enablement and efficiency gains.

**Data Analysis & Reporting:**

* Collect, structure, and analyze commercial and operational data to evaluate potential bank partnership opportunities.
* Prepare regular reporting dashboards, pipeline performance reviews, and market/competitor analyses for sales leaders and management.

**Cross-Functional Operations & Enablement:**

* Coordinate with internal teams including Legal, Compliance, Product, and Integration Engineering to streamline the onboarding process for new bank partners.
* Help create, maintain, and update sales collateral, onboarding checklists, training materials, and process documentation.
* Assist in managing sales tools, ensuring seamless integrations and optimal usage across the sales team.

**Your Profile**

**Education & Experience:**

* Master/ Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Development, Commercial Operations, or Management Consulting is a plus (internships and working student roles in fast-paced FinTech/B2B Tech environments qualify).

**Technical & Analytical Skills:**

* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and office tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides).
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive presentations.
* Basic familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) is a plus.
* Previous experience with Google Scripts is a plus.

**Soft Skills & Mindset:**

* Excellent organizational skills, detail orientation, and ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-moving environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams.
* Proactive, hands-on, problem-solving attitude with a genuine interest in FinTech and B2B banking partnerships.

**Languages:**

* Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.
* Additional European languages are a strong plus.

**Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!**

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

* Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
* Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
* A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
* Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.
* Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
* Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
* Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
* You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

*Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy*

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Praktikum AI & Automation – Virtual Power Plant (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb. Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live. AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran. Dein Profil Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt. Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building. Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein. Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen. Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 20 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Revenue Enablement Specialist
description:
**At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.**

**Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.**

Moss is scaling fast, and our commercial team is growing with it. That means Revenue Enablement has more exciting projects to deliver in 2027. We are looking for a Revenue Enablement Specialist to join our Revenue Enablement Lead and turn that growth into consistent, repeatable results across our revenue teams.

This is a rare 0 to 1 opportunity. You will build onboarding, training programs and knowledge management, and see them used in the field. You will also help bring AI-enabled workflows into everyday selling.

Maybe you are an experienced enabler who wants something new and adventurous. Maybe you are a seller who wants to turn what works for you into something that helps a whole team win. Either way, you will have real room to build and make an impact. You will report to the Revenue Enablement Lead, sitting within RevOps function and who sets the strategy and KPIs. You will work with xDR and AE teams, and support other commercial teams as priorities change. You will partner with Sales, RevOps , Product, Automation and PMM, so enablement works in the field and its impact can be measured.

**Projects you will work on**
-----------------------------

* **Commercial onboarding:** Build and run onboarding that helps new hires ramp faster and sell with confidence.
* **xDR programmes:** Deliver enablement programmes for our xDR teams.
* **Product enablement:** Work with the Product enablement team on ad hoc projects, such as getting new features and launches into the field.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Build the Revenue Enablement foundation:** Build and run the core enablement system within the strategy set by the Lead. This includes sales playbooks, onboarding programmes, training cadence and manager-led coaching frameworks.
* **Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows:** Take existing AI initiatives (e.g. MEDDIC coaching, BDR Coach, knowledge retrieval systems) and make them part of how teams really work. Adoption is the goal.
* **Embed enablement into the operating rhythm:** Bring it into onboarding, weekly team meetings, deal reviews and pipeline management, with support from frontline managers.
* **Centralise knowledge and enablement tools:** Build on one source of truth for GTM content. Set up lightweight tools (call libraries, LMS pilots, structured workflows) with clear ownership, easy search and consistent use.
* **Track and improve revenue impact:** Track and report on the KPIs agreed with RevOps and the Lead (ramp time, win rate, ACV, forecast hygiene, MEDDIC completeness, workflow adoption). Run targeted pilots and improve programmes based on results.
* **Work independently:** Once scope is approved, you deliver from start to finish and manage your own stakeholders.

**About you**
-------------

* 3 to 5 years in enablement, RevOps, sales operations or a similar GTM role in high-growth B2B SaaS, or a seller with a strong record of coaching peers.
* You use AI tools well to work faster and help GTM teams adopt them.
* You can work alone once the goal and scope are clear.
* German language skills are a nice to have, not a requirement.

**Skills and attributes**
-------------------------

* **Builder:** You build from zero with clarity and discipline and create repeatable systems (MEDDIC, onboarding, coaching, governance).
* **Operator:** You are practical and focused on revenue outcomes. You turn frameworks into playbooks, rubrics, templates and training that teams use.
* **Data-driven:** You link enablement to measurable impact, run fast pilots and improve based on data.
* **Cross-functional connector:** You work with Sales, PMM, Product, CS and RevOps. You turn field feedback into GTM insights and respect who owns what.
* **AI and workflow enabler:** You are comfortable with AI tools and automation and know how to build them into GTM processes.
* **Systems thinker:** You design knowledge, tools and AI workflows that reduce friction and give people one trusted source of truth without heavy process.

**About Moss**

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's **what else to expect:**

* Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
* Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
* Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

*Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).*

***By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our*** ***Data Privacy Policy******.***

title: People Operations Manager
description:
Deltia is growing fast, and we need someone to own the operational backbone that makes that possible. As our People Operations Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our Talent & People Manager to scale our team from ~30 to 100+ people over the next two years. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of compliance, process design, and employee experience.

**What you'll own**

* **Employment & legal:** End-to-end management of employment contracts, work permits, and visa processes in Germany and internationally, including EOR arrangements
* **Payroll:** Running and overseeing monthly payroll, ensuring accuracy and compliance across entities
* **Benefits:** Managing our existing benefits stack and proactively identifying, proposing, and implementing new offerings as we scale
* **Team culture:** Planning and coordinating team events and off-sites, both locally and abroad
* **Office operations:** Acting as the point of contact for our coworking space and handling day-to-day operational needs
* **HR processes & compliance:** Designing, documenting, and improving people processes as we grow, with a strong eye on German labor law and cross-border compliance topics

**Room to grow**  
Depending on your interests and background, there's space to own more:

* **Onboarding & offboarding:** Design and iterate the full employee lifecycle experience as we scale
* **HRIS & tooling:** Own the evaluation and rollout of our HR system of record
* **People analytics:** Build lightweight reporting on headcount, attrition, and hiring velocity to support decision-making
* **Learning & development:** Lay the groundwork for how Deltia invests in its people as the team matures

**What we're looking for**

* 2-4 years in People Ops, HR, or a closely related role, ideally in a fast-growing startup
* Solid understanding of German employment law; experience with international hiring or EORs is a plus
* Structured, hands-on, and comfortable operating with limited oversight
* Fluent in English; German is a strong plus

Start ASAP in Berlin - Hybrid  
  
#LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

Compensation Range: $50K - $65K

title: Associate Analyst, Business Operations - (Fixed Term) (Labeling Operations, Consumer)
description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

 **Job Description**

Learning nonstop. Innovation on tap. As an **Associate Analyst** you'll run the day-to-day of our labeling operations: planning capacity across concurrent projects, owning guidelines and quality standards, and working with partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa. The labeled data you oversee feeds the Search and Recommendation systems that serve millions of requests every day.

The Labeling Operations team sits in the Consumer Discovery organization and produces the labeled data behind Search, Recommendation and Intent Collection. Together with a team of around 14–16 interns, we set the guidelines, tooling and quality standards that keep that data consistent. We work closely with external partner teams at Talabat and PedidosYa.

At Delivery Hero, you'll shape the global consumer experience for millions of users. Your work will have a direct impact on how we attract and retain customers, creating data-driven, personalized interactions that keep them coming back. As part of our Consumer Team, you'll enhance customer satisfaction and drive global growth and profitability through innovative projects.

* Plan capacity across concurrent labeling projects and drive weekly and monthly prioritization.
* Scope and set up labeling projects end to end, maintain and evolve the guidelines, and advise stakeholders on labeling standards.
* Review work quality and process compliance, and report results to stakeholders.
* Act as the main point of contact for external partner teams such as Talabat and PedidosYa.
* Onboard new labelers and support hiring by reviewing candidate case studies and planning capacity for new joiners.
* Label data hands-on when the team needs it.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or in progress) in a related field such as Business, Finance, Accounting or Engineering.
* Fluency in spoken and written English and **Spanish.**
* Ability to work accurately with large amounts of data and documents, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong organization and communication skills, and experience working with different stakeholders.
* Experience defining guidelines or rules for large projects.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data labeling tools.
* Experience working with Talabat or PedidosYa teams, and a good understanding of their markets.
* General knowledge of food culture and traditions.

  
**Additional Information**

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

* Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
* We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
* We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
* Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
* Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
* The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
* Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together 10 things you should know about moving to Berlin and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
* Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers created in collaboration with our recruiters.

*Heads up: exact benefits may look a little different for intern, working student, fixed-term, and part-time roles.*

Ready to join our team? If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Startup Community Manager (f/m/d)
description:
#### **Your mission**

At MotionLab.Berlin, startups are our passion and our driving force—their success is our success. As our Startup Community Manager, you ensure our founders have everything they need to build better products and find capital more easily.

The Startup Community Manager turns this promise into a working service for every startup in our ecosystem. You know what each startup needs next and connect it to the right partner, expert, program or investor at the right time: you are the spider in the web of our ecosystem, not a mentor. The role is responsible for the startup accounts of MotionLab.Berlin, from account onboarding to alumni status, and represents our ecosystem in the Berlin and German deep tech network.

  
What You Own

### **Startup Community & Account Management**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes for startups entering and exiting the MotionLab.Berlin ecosystem.
* **Founder Support:** Maintain a close pulse on startup needs and stage-specific challenges to understand their evolving needs, facilitating meaningful connections and introductions that accelerate their growth.
* **Community Events & Knowledge Sharing:** Ideate, plan, and execute community events and masterclasses (e.g., DeepTech Nexus, Investor Dinners, Fireside Chats, and specialized "How-To" sessions).
* **Internal Synergy:** Collaborate closely with the Front Desk and Community teams to stay aligned on founder needs, emerging trends, and daily space dynamics.
* **New Support Offers:** Turn needs that several startups share into new formats, partnerships or services.

### **Startup Program Execution**

* **DeepTech Mentoring Program:** Lead the mentoring track for DeepTech Award winners, managing their onboarding and periodic progress check-ins.
* **EIT DRIVE Berlin:** Own our EIT Urban Mobility project as Ecosystem Agent for Germany: source and assess urban mobility startups, prepare investment recommendations, deliver the program events and write all deliverable and KPI reports, including budget responsibility.
* **Program Logistics:** Support all MotionLab.Berlin programs by sourcing, organizing, and coordinating workshops, speakers, and domain experts.

### **External Ecosystem & Network Building**

* **Active Networking:** Build and grow a network of other hubs, initiatives and players; participate in events (min. 2 per month) and conferences to strengthen connections and represent the MotionLab.Berlin offer
* **DeepTech Landscape Mapping:** Actively track and map the Berlin DeepTech and hardware startup landscape to identify key actors and growth-stage companies.
* **Pipeline & Opportunity Identification:** Leverage market insights to identify startups for integration into our programs, as well as inspiring founders and experts for upcoming events.
* **Partner & Expert Network:** Build and maintain our pool of experts, mentors and investors and embed our partners into startup formats and introductions, so that they see real value from their partnership.

#### **Your profile**

**Non-Negotiable**

* **3+ years experience in** **Community or Account Management:** hands-on experience in account management, startup incubation/acceleration, community management, or ecosystem building.
* **Program & Event Ownership:** Demonstrated track record of conceptualizing and successfully executing high-impact programs or events.
* **Startup Ecosystem Knowledge:** Solid understanding of the German and Berlin startup scene—especially around hardware, deep-tech, and emerging technologies.

**Bonus Points If You Have:**

* **Deep-Tech & Hardware Knowledge:** Understanding of hardware startup operations, prototyping phases, and hardware-specific funding models.
* **Ecosystem Connections:** A strong network across founders, investors, and key players in the Berlin/German startup community.
* **Public Grant & Program Exposure:** Hands-on experience working with public frameworks like EIT or municipal/state innovation awards.

**Your Mindset & Skills**

* **Proactive Founder Advocate:** Excellent interpersonal skills with an empathetic, solutions-oriented approach to supporting founders through their scaling challenges.
* **High Operational Drive:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple program streams and community initiatives simultaneously.
* **Networker:** A natural curiosity for mapping market dynamics, identifying high-potential startups, and spotting key trends across the ecosystem.
* **Communication & Languages:** Fluent in English with strong written and verbal skills (German fluency is highly advantageous given local stakeholder and public program coordination).

#### **Why us?**

* **Be the person every founder knows:** You work with the startups of Germany’s official Deep Tech Hub every day, in our MakerGarages, Offices and Community, and you see directly what your introductions change for them.
* **Build, don’t just run:** You won’t inherit a finished playbook. You will write it: how we onboard startups, how we match them with partners, experts and investors, and which new formats our ecosystem needs.
* **Own real projects:** You lead EIT DRIVE Berlin and the Deep Tech Mentoring program end to end, with your own budget, partners and results.
* **A network that opens doors:** 110+ companies on campus, corporate partners, investors and the de:hub network. With ringberlin and its 17,000 m², the ecosystem you build now will grow with you.
* **Short decision paths, high visibility:** You work closely with leadership, and your output directly shapes the success of our startups and corporate partners.
* **A culture that is honest, learning-oriented, and community-driven:** We celebrate wins, discuss failures openly, and treat feedback as a tool.
* **Transparency:** We do not pay top corporate-level salaries. If maximum cash is your primary driver, this is probably not the right move. If you are motivated by ownership, impact and the chance to shape how hardtech startups grow in Berlin, this is a rare opportunity

#### **About us**

MotionLab.Berlin is Germany's premier Innovation Hub & Makerspace, an ecosystem for Hardtech, art, creativity, and entrepreneurship. On 5,500 sqm in Berlin-Alt-Treptow we run eight specialist labs, private offices, MakerGarages and event spaces for more than 110 deep tech companies. MotionLab.Berlin is the operating and founding partner of Berlin's official Deep Tech Hub, certified within Germany's national de:hub initiative.  
Three programs cover the full journey: the Tech Talent Program puts students on real industry challenges, the Hardtech Innovation Accelerator takes early-stage founders from idea to product without taking equity, and Deep Tech in Motion opens international markets. Next up: ringberlin, our second campus in Berlin-Tempelhof with 17,000 sqm.  
Working at MotionLab.Berlin means building the place where hardware gets built. You work next to the founders you support, in a hall with a double-decker bus, a CNC lab and a Demo Day stage. Small team, short decisions, real responsibility from day one. English is our working language.  
Questions about a role? Write to hiring@motionlab.berlin, we read every mail. Let's build.

title: EU-Expansion & Business Analytics (m/w/d) Werkstudent:in (Berlin/Bonn/Frankfurt)
description: Über ELMI: ELMI ist ein Technologieunternehmen für batteriegestützte Ultra-Schnellladestationen. Unsere Mission ist es, weit mehr als klassische Ladesäulen zu entwickeln: Wir schaffen intelligente Energielösungen, die flexibel mit den Anforderungen von morgen mitwachsen, Ressourcen schonen und Netze entlasten – und so die Energiewende Schritt für Schritt in die Praxis bringen. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Business Development & Expansion bist du eine zentrale Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung unseres Markteintritts in den europäischen Raum. Dein Fokus liegt auf der fundierten Analyse und Bewertung neuer europäischer Märkte sowie der Erstellung von Business Cases, die als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die geplante Expansion dienen. Du begleitest den Aufbau der Europa-Expansion von den ersten Marktanalysen und Business Cases bis hin zur Entwicklung konkreter Umsetzungsschritte, erhältst dabei tiefe Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungsprozesse und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich stark weiterzuentwickeln. Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Business Cases zur Bewertung neuer Märkte und Expansionsmöglichkeiten in Europa Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Identifikation vielversprechender europäischer Zielmärkte Erstellung von Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management Mitarbeit bei der Automatisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen Recherche zu regulatorischen, wirtschaftlichen und kulturellen Rahmenbedingungen einzelner europäischer Länder Unterstützung bei der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern Pflege und Weiterentwicklung interner Tools/Datenbanken (z. B. in Odoo) zur Unterstützung der Expansionsplanung Eigenständige Bearbeitung kleinerer Projekte oder Teilaufgaben im Rahmen der Europa-Strategie Qualifikation Eingeschriebene:r Student:in der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs Erste Erfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an Business-Case-Analysen und wirtschaftlichen Bewertungen neuer Marktchancen Sicherer Umgang mit MS Excel und PowerPoint, insbesondere für Finanzmodelle und Präsentationen Analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen sowie eine zahlenaffine Arbeitsweise Grundkenntnisse oder Interesse an Coding/Vibe-Coding Interesse an internationalen Märkten und der Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsstrategien für den europäischen Raum Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM- oder BI-Software (z. B. Odoo, Power BI, Tableau) von Vorteil Von Vorteil: Programmiererfahrung, auch mit Unterstützung von KI Benefits Entspannte Arbeitsatmosphäre: Bei uns geht es professionell, aber unkompliziert zu – wir pflegen einen offenen und lockeren Umgang miteinander. Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Egal, ob Kolleg:in oder Geschäftsführung – bei uns zählt die Idee, nicht die Position. Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deine Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und eigene Ideen einzubringen. Gemeinsam statt nebeneinander: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und lösen Herausforderungen als Team. Direkter Austausch: Fragen, Feedback und neue Ideen werden offen angesprochen – ohne unnötige Abstimmungswege. Start-up-Mentalität: Wir geben Raum für neue Ideen, mutige Entscheidungen und eigene Lösungen. Nicht alles muss auf Anhieb perfekt sein – wir lernen aus unseren Erfahrungen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter. Technologie mit Sinn: Du arbeitest an innovativen, batteriegestützten Ladelösungen und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft der Elektromobilität mit. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität gestaltet. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht schon bald als Teil unseres Teams begrüßen zu dürfen! Bewirb dich jetzt – und bring deine Energie dorthin, wo sie wirklich etwas bewegt!

title: AI Platform Engineer - Edgy device (m/f/d)
description:
**AI Platform Engineer - Edgy device**

Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for an **AI Platform Engineer** who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it.

**What you'll do**

* Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates.
* Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks.
* Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware.
* Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms.
* Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS).
* Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site.

**You are**

* 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles.
* Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell.
* Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls.
* Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.
* Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again.

**Nice to have**

* Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom).
* AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management.
* NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA.
* Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...).
* Kubernetes in production.
* Video, camera or ML inference workloads.

**Why this role matters**

You'll keep our systems running smoothly and help the team ship with confidence. And if you're curious about ML, you'll get real exposure to production AI systems.

#LI-SP1 #LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

title: Working Student Business Analytics & Supply Chain Excellence (internship)
description: Introduction to the job In the “Enabling Functions” sector, you may not come into direct contact with our products, but with your expertise you make a significant contribution to ensuring that our company runs smoothly. Only together with colleagues from these structured, high-performing, and supportive departments—such as Human Resources, Accounting, Controlling, IT, and Communications—are we able to grow beyond ourselves and achieve our goals as a company. The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function supports effective procurement and supply chain decisions through reliable processes, transparent data, and consistent reporting. Role and responsibilities As a Working Student Business Analytics & Supply Chain Excellence, you will: analyze, document, and support the optimization of existing procurement and supply chain processes and tools. develop, maintain, and improve key performance indicators, reports, and dashboards. perform recurring and ad hoc analyses covering quality, logistics, costs, and supplier performance. prepare and structure data using Microsoft Excel, Spotfire, Power BI, and other reporting tools. support the standardization of reporting solutions, data sets, and operational updates. contribute to selected process improvement, analytics, and system integration projects. prepare presentations, documentation, and decision-making materials for relevant stakeholders. Education and experience Current bachelor’s or master’s studies in logistics, supply chain management, industrial engineering, business information systems, business administration, or a comparable field Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and lookup functions Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint Knowledge of SAP, Spotfire, Power BI, or comparable analytics and reporting tools Understanding of procurement, supply chain management, process management, or business analytics Fluency in written and spoken German and English Skills Working with procurement and supply chain data in an international high-tech environment requires accuracy, adaptability, and effective collaboration with different stakeholders. To succeed in this role, the following skills are important: Structured and accurate approach when working with complex data sets, processes, and reporting requirements Analytical problem-solving when identifying patterns, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities Ability to organize priorities and deliver reliable results within agreed timelines Independent working style combined with timely coordination when requirements or data are unclear Willingness to learn new processes, systems, and data structures in a changing environment Clear communication of analytical findings to stakeholders with different professional backgrounds Collaborative approach when working across functions and in an international environment Other information Diversity and inclusion ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that diversity and inclusion is a driving force in the success of our company. title: DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System (m/f/d)
description:
**DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System**

Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for a **DevOps Engineer** who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it.

**What you'll do**

* Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates.
* Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks.
* Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware.
* Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms.
* Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS).
* Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site.

**You are**

* 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles.
* Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell.
* Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls.
* Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS.
* Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again.

**Nice to have**

* Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom).
* AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management.
* NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA.
* Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...).
* Kubernetes in production.
* Video, camera or ML inference workloads.

**Why this role matters**

You'll keep our systems running smoothly and help the team ship with confidence. And if you're curious about ML, you'll get real exposure to production AI systems.

#LI-SP1 #LI-Hybrid

**What we offer**

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees\*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software  
  
**Don't meet all the requirements?**

*Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.*

* *Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.*

title: Workplace Manager (m/f/d) | Legal AI Tech Scale-up | Berlin Onsite
description:
#### **Your team**

At Noxtua, we're building Europe's Legal AI, and our Berlin office is where engineers, lawyers, product, sales, and communications people come together. As our Office Manager, you'll make that office a place people like coming to, where guests feel welcome, and where everything from the coffee machine to access badges works. You'll be the first point of contact for everyone in the office. You'll work closely with People, Finance, our SysAdmin and Compliance, and with the management team.

You'll report to Bensan Öndül, our VP People & Culture. Bensan leads our People & Culture team and cares about how people grow at Noxtua, from feedback and onboarding conversations to manager guidance and training. She'll give you the freedom to own the office and its projects, and the support to make them a success.

#### **About you**

* You have **5 years plus of experience as an office manager** or in office administration, ideally at a tech company or scale-up. Experience planning or running an office move is a big plus.
* You run an office day-to-day on your own, from **suppliers, facilities and repairs to the office budget,** and you notice what needs doing before anyone asks.
* You know the German **health and safety requirements (Arbeitsschutz)** for an office and have created or maintained the policies that go with them, for example risk assessments, safety briefings and first-aid or fire-safety roles.
* You are highly **organised, reliable and discreet with confidential information,** and you stay friendly and calm when ten things land at once.
* You work confidently with **Microsoft 365** and pick up new tools quickly; experience with **Finway, Perk** or similar systems is a plus.
* You speak fluent **German** and **English** and are based in Berlin.

#### **Your responsibilities**

* **Office and facilities:** run our Berlin office day-to-day: supplies, kitchen, mail, cleaning, repairs, meeting rooms, and contact with the landlord and building management, plus office suppliers, contracts, and the office budget, passing invoices to Finance.
* **Office move:** Support to search for offices in 3 other locations, and take ownership of other hubs. Plan and run our move to a new office as your first big project, from timeline, movers, furniture to infrastructure.
* **Health and safety (Arbeitsschutz):** own health and safety in the office: create and maintain our policies, keep risk assessments (Gefährdungsbeurteilungen) up to date, organise safety briefings, and make sure first-aiders and fire-safety officers are in place, working with external safety experts where needed.
* **Front desk and office security:** welcome customers, partners and candidates, manage the visitor log, access badges and keys, and support clean-desk rules, providing evidence for our ISO 27001, TISAX and BSI C5 audits together with Compliance.
* **J****oiners and leavers:** prepare desks, keys and welcome packs, and coordinate day-one set-up and equipment returns with People and our SysAdmin.
* **Team life and gifts:** organise team lunches, office days and small get-togethers, and take ownership of gifts for birthdays, weddings, new babies and other special moments, working closely with a working student.

#### **Our offer to you**

Building Europe’s sovereign Legal AI is ambitious, meaningful work — and we want the people doing it to be properly looked after. Our benefits are built around flexibility, real-time off to recharge, and the setup to do your best work.

* **Working hours:** Flexible working hours.
* **Vacation:** 26 days + December 24th & 31st off + 1 additional vacation day per year of employment (up to 30 days).
* **Discounts:** e.g., Urban Sports Club membership.
* **Equipment:** Laptop (Lenovo or Mac), plus home-office setup budget (paid with your first salary).

#### **About us**

Noxtua (noxtua.com) is Europe's Legal AI built for legal professionals in law firms, legal departments, public administration, and the judiciary. Its AI covers the full workflow of legal text work: research, analysis of complex legal issues, and document drafting. Noxtua is built to meet the professional, criminal, and data protection requirements specific to the legal profession — including Section 203 of the German Criminal Code and Section 43e of the Federal Code for Lawyers — and holds certifications including BSI C5, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001. In partnership with leading European legal publishers, Noxtua is also building Europe's largest legal database, with more than 130 million searchable documents, and offering the market's first cross-continental European license.  
  
Founded in 2017 in Berlin on research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbæk and Professor Dr. Michael Huth at Oxford University and Imperial College London, the company has offices in Paris, Berlin, Stockholm, Zagreb, Munich and Fribourg. Strategic investors include C.H.BECK, and MANZ, who have committed around €100 million as part of a Series C round in 2026.  
  
**We explicitly encourage women to apply, as they are currently underrepresented. Our goal is to build a diverse and inclusive work environment that values different perspectives. Of course, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals – regardless of gender, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual identity.**

title: Working Student Market Communication & Balancing Group Management (m/f/d)
description:
Second Foundation is an international energy trading and asset management firm. We are headquartered in Prague and have offices in Switzerland, Germany, Japan and the US. Our team of 500+ people is active in 25 power markets, where we turn complex data into trading strategies using proprietary technology and quantitative models. We are also building a growing portfolio of large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Germany and other countries, which we operate, prequalify and market ourselves. In Germany, we act as a balance responsible party (BRP), supplier and direct marketer for renewable energy. That puts us exactly where assets, grid operators, data and trading meet.

We are looking for a Working Student to join our Energy Data & Operations team in Berlin, where market communication, balancing group settlement and the integration of new assets all come together. You will work closely with our Energy Data Manager and our Technical Sales Support Specialist and support both in day-to-day operations and automation projects.

**What would** **you** **work on?**

* Supporting market communication with grid operators and metering point operators under GPKE and MaBiS, including asset registrations and switches, master data reconciliation and resolving error messages (UTILMD, MSCONS, APERAK)
* Taking over parts of the balancing group settlement (BKA and KBKA): reconciling settlement data, analysing discrepancies and clarifying them with grid operators
* Maintaining and validating master data and time series data in our energy data system
* Researching regulatory topics such as BNetzA rulings, EDI@Energy formats and new market processes, and turning relevant findings into changes in our processes and systems, so your work has a direct impact on how we operate
* Automating recurring workflows with Python, SQL and AI tools, for example detecting missing meter data or reconciling data sets
* Supporting day-to-day direct marketing operations and the integration of new generation assets and battery storage systems, together with our VPP team in Prague

**What makes you a great candidate?**

* You are enrolled in a Master's programme, ideally in engineering, industrial engineering, business administration with a quantitative focus, mathematics or computer science
* You think analytically and are confident working with data; Python or SQL are a big plus
* Knowledge of the power market or the energy industry is an advantage, but not a requirement
* You are highly motivated to learn, because regulation and processes keep changing and new topics come up all the time
* You work in a structured, thorough way, since deadlines and data quality are critical for us
* You are fluent in German and have good English skills

**What do we offer?**

* Real responsibility from day one and deep insight into power trading, balancing and battery storage
* Direct impact: your research and automation ideas are put into practice
* Flexible working hours that fit around your studies, plus hybrid working
* High-end work equipment, with devices available from Apple, Samsung or Lenovo
* An international team in a fast-growing part of the energy transition
* The possibility of a permanent position after graduation
* BVG Deutschlandticket Job, Edenred meal vouchers and Urban Sports Club membership
* Team-building activities and company events

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
description:
**Location**: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

**Classification**: Full-time

**Pay Range**: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

**About Miaplaza**

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

**What you’ll work on**

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

**How management works at Miaplaza**

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

* You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.
* You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.
* You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.
* Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.

**What you must bring**

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

* 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages
* 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework
* 3+ years of experience with software architecture
* 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level
* 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader
* 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead
* Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization
* Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

**What makes you stand out**

* Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration
* Experience with consumer platforms at scale
* Experience building in regulated environments
* Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)
* Extensive senior front-end development experience

**Responsibilities**

* Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js
* Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families
* Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.
* Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc
* Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

**Our hiring process**

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

* **Application and CV review.** We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.
* **Initial technical screen (20 min).** A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.
* **Behavioral interview (1 hour).** With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.
* **1st technical interview (1 hour).** With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.
* **2nd technical interview (1 hour).** With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.
* **Leadership interview (1 hour).** With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.
* **Reference check.** We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.
* **Offer and background check.** Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

**Compensation**

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

Du kommunizierst klar und traust Dich, Auffälligkeiten direkt anzusprechen, auch gegenüber Führungskräften. Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Innerhalb des Tages stimmst Du Deine Arbeitszeiten auf Deine Vorlesungen ab. In der Prüfungsphase finden wir gemeinsam eine Lösung. Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte – Zentral gelegen, mit bester Anbindung und freundlicher Atmosphäre. Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg. Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck. FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier. Office Dogs welcome – Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns herzlich willkommen. Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht, ein paar Sätze, warum Dich die Stelle reizt, freuen uns aber. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Pflegia ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Bei uns zählt nicht, woher Du kommst, sondern wohin Du gemeinsam mit uns willst.

Deine Aufgaben: Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung. Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
