title: Junior Partnerships Coordinator DE
description:
The campaign needs the right assets. The partner needs their tickets. The event team needs a clear brief. And somewhere between the last approval and the arena doors opening, someone needs to make sure it all comes together.

That someone could be you.

At OKTAGON, our partners are part of the experience we create for fans. From campaigns to live activations, what we promise them needs to work in practice.

We’re looking for a **Junior Partnerships Coordinator** to help look after our partners in Germany and Austria. You’ll work alongside our Partnership and Activation Specialist, learn how sports partnerships work from the inside and gradually take responsibility for your own accounts.

**Early in your career? Good. This role is built for that.**

You don’t need a long list of sponsorship deals on your CV. Some first experience, a structured approach and the confidence to pick up the phone will take you a long way.

**What will you actually do?**
------------------------------

**Make sure our partners know what’s happening.**

You’ll support everyday communication with our German-speaking partners, help new partners get started and keep track of what we’ve agreed to deliver. You’ll collect information, chase approvals and follow up before a missing answer becomes a last-minute problem.

As you learn the ropes, you’ll take over smaller accounts and provide cover for our Partnership and Activation Specialist when needed.

**Turn agreements into things people can see.**

Logos, advertising materials, German copy, campaign assets. You’ll help get everything to the right people, in the right format and on time.

That means working closely with our Commercial teams in Prague and Bratislava, coordinating with our graphic designer and checking that partner branding and German texts are correct before they go live.

You’ll also support ticketing, accreditations and invoicing information. Yes, there’s admin. Getting it right makes a real difference to the partner’s experience.

**Be there when it all goes live.**

Before each tournament, you’ll help prepare partner information and make sure the relevant departments understand what needs to happen.

On site, you’ll welcome partners, help with questions and check that agreed placements and activations are delivered. You’ll document them with photos, so we can show partners exactly what their collaboration with OKTAGON looked like.

**Help us build the next opportunity.**

You’ll organise incoming partnership enquiries, research potential partners and support tailored offers and pitch decks. You’ll also adapt sales materials into German and English.

Over time, you’ll learn to spot opportunities within existing partnerships. A campaign that could go further. An activation worth repeating. A conversation that could lead to a renewal.

**Keep everyone connected.**

You’ll work with marketing, social media and other teams across Germany, Prague and Bratislava to make sure partner campaigns fit the OKTAGON brand and happen as agreed.

A big part of this role is knowing who needs what — and making sure they actually get it.

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

**Someone who follows through.**

You keep track of deadlines, remember the details and ask when something isn’t clear. If an approval is missing, you follow up. If plans change, you help figure out the next step.

You’re comfortable speaking with partners and colleagues, whether that means writing a clear email, making a call or welcoming someone at an event.

You should bring:

* **German at C1 level and fluent English.** You’ll use both regularly in partner communication and across our international team.
* **Some first experience in sports, events, sponsorship or agency work.** Internships and working student roles absolutely count.
* **A structured, reliable way of working.** Several partners, several deadlines, plenty of details. You can keep an overview.
* **Clear communication and a friendly, confident approach.** People should feel comfortable coming to you — and trust that you’ll follow up.
* **Willingness to travel and work event weekends.** Expect involvement in around nine tournaments per year, including events in Germany and Austria.

**And yes, event weekends are part of the job.**

Some of the most rewarding moments will happen when the arena fills up. Some of the busiest ones will happen just before that. We want you to know what you’re signing up for.

**A few things that would help**
--------------------------------

You don’t need to tick every box here, but we’d be happy to see:

* A degree in sports management, business or communications.
* Video or content creation skills.
* Experience with Asana and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with the German sponsorship market.
* An interest in combat sports.
* Czech or Slovak language skills.

**Where could this take you?**
------------------------------

**Junior is your starting point. There’s room to grow from there.**

During your first three months, you’ll learn our partnership products and processes, shadow colleagues at events and take on your first coordination tasks.

Around months four to six, the aim is for you to start looking after smaller partner accounts and provide more support at events.

As your confidence and experience grow, you could build your own partner portfolio and contribute to renewals and additional partnership opportunities.

A move towards a **Partnerships Specialist role after roughly 12–18 months** is a possible next step, depending on your development and the team’s needs.

**What does doing this well look like?**
----------------------------------------

Partners know what to expect. Deadlines are under control. Tickets and accreditations are correct. What we promised is delivered — and we have the documentation to show it.

You’ll help the team deliver at least **98% of agreed partner commitments at each event** and provide the information needed for partner reports within **10 working days afterwards**.

As you gain experience, we’ll also look for your ideas on how existing partnerships could grow.

**Ready to get started?**
-------------------------

Maybe you’ve supported events during an internship. Maybe you’ve spent time in an agency and want to work more closely with a sports brand. Or maybe you’ve had your first taste of sponsorship and want to build a career in it.

**We’d like to hear from you.**

Send us your CV and a few lines about why this role interests you. Tell us what you’ve already tried, what you enjoyed and what you’d like to learn next.

Let’s talk.

description: Begleite KPMG bei den zukünftigen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und Kundinnen. Deine Aufgaben Du hast ein Talent zum Organisieren, Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge spielend durchdringen und technisches Know-how mit fachlicher Expertise verknüpfen? Dann bring Dich bei uns ein: Als Mitarbeiter Projekt- / Prozessmanagement Finance (w/m/d) bist Du für PM/PMO-Tätigkeiten wie z.B. Projektorganisation, -planung und -durchführung verantwortlich. Du erarbeitest fachliche Lösungskonzepte zum Ausbau und zur Verbesserung der Finance-Prozesse. Du agierst als Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen der IT und den Fachbereichen bei Themen wie der Projektumsetzung oder der Koordination zwischen den Beteiligten. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du bei operativen Fragestellungen. Du hilfst dem Core Finance oder Order to Cash Team bei dem Projektcontrolling, der Prozessdokumentation und bei den laufenden Prozess- und Systemanpassungen. Das Core Finance Team übernimmt die fachliche Betreuung der SAP-Module FI, CO, CATS (Zeiterfassung), Treasury und des Konsolidierungstools SEM-BCS. Das Order to Cash Team betreut die Finance-Prozesse zur Abbildung der KPMG Dienstleistungen von der Auftragsanlage über die Leistungserfassung und die Bestandsermittlung bis hin zur Rechnungsstellung und dem Mahnwesen. Die Unterstützung bei der Ausarbeitung von Kommunikationsplänen und Schulungsunterlagen rundet Deinen Aufgabenbereich ab. Dein Profil Mitarbeiter Projekt- / Prozessmanager Finance (w/m/d) wirst Du bei uns mit einem abgeschlossenen Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren (kaufmännischen) Ausbildung. Du bringst erste relevante Praxiserfahrung im Bereich Finanzen / Controlling / Rechnungswesen mit. Zudem verfügst Du über erste Erfahrung mit Projektarbeiten. Vorteilhaft sind Erfahrungen mit SAP sowie erste Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und in der Buchhaltung oder im Controlling. Idealerweise hast Du Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA / FI / SD / CO / MM / SRM, ARIBA / SEM-BCS und Business Intelligence Anwendungen (z.B. SAP BI). Deutschkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus. Sehr gute Moderations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen Dich aus. Der sichere Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint rundet Deine Qualifikationen ab. Deine Benefits Willkommen im Team Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team. Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Mit unserer Vielfalt an spannenden Kunden und Kundinnen sowie Fragestellungen bieten wir Dir interessante Karrieremöglichkeiten und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche. Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren. Fort- & Weiterbildung Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Dich stetig weiter. Die abgebildeten Leistungen können je nach Position und Standort leicht variieren.

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**  
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €**10k to** **€****300k**, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world**: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting**: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
* **You have innate curiosity in how businesses work**: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
* **You are a life-long learner**: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
* **You build genuine relationships with your customers**: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
* **You want to be with the best**: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

* + **Own your destiny:** Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for **80-90% net-new logo acquisition** through self-sourced pipeline.
  + **Get In Early:** The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  + **Sharpen Your Edge:** Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

* **Winning DNA:** Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
* **Over-achievement:** A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
* **Strategic Grit:** Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
* **Native German** language speakers

Advantageous:

* **Intellectual Curiosity:** You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
* **A Repeatable Sales Framework:** You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
* **A Data-Minded Approach:** You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
* **Continuous Process Iteration:** You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

title: Sales Manager (Campus & Startup Programs) (f/m/d)
description:
#### **Your mission**

You expand your scope step by step. In the first six months you drive Campus and Tech Talent sales; once that foundation is strong, Event Space sales and the sales foundation follow.  
**1. Campus Sales (MakerGarages, Offices & Memberships)**

* **End-to-end startup sales funnel for MakerGarages and Offices across campuses.**
* Membership sales to creatives, students, and early-stage startups (online and on-site).
* Lead qualification, campus tours, proposal generation, negotiation, and deal closing.
* Pipeline cleanliness and CRM documentation.
* Smooth member onboarding and handovers to Campus & Community teams.

**2. Tech Talent Program Sales (Tech Challenges for SMEs)**  

* Proactive outreach and target identification of SMEs / Mittelstand and innovation units in the DACH region (primarily Germany).
* The full B2B sales cycle: outreach, discovery, scoping, proposal, negotiation, and closing.
* Relationship management to convert initial projects into long-term, recurring partnerships.

**3. Event Space Sales Strategy & Execution**  

* Proactive target identification and outreach to potential event clients aligned with our strategic goals.
* Lead conversion and repeat business strategies in collaboration with the Events & Marketing teams.
* Strategic positioning, pricing, and packaging for event spaces, in close collaboration with the Events Manager.

**4. Sales Foundation & Strategy**  

* Setup, optimization, and reporting for sales processes and CRM systems.
* Development of core sales collateral and playbooks (templates, scripts, pitch decks).
* Direct feedback loops with Product, Campus, and Program teams to refine product offerings.
* Groundwork and team-building structures to scale the sales department as the business expands.

#### **Your profile**

This role is designed for someone with meaningful work experience, who now wants to take real ownership and build something that matters.  
**Non-Negotiable**

  

* Several years of experience (ideally 2–5+ years) in Sales, e.g. in startups, coworking, or B2B services.
* Fluent German (C1+) – you are confident speaking with SMEs and non-startup stakeholders.
* Very good English – our startup ecosystem and community are international.
* Proven track record of owning the full sales cycle: from cold outreach / inbound lead, to needs analysis and proposal, to negotiation and closing.
* Ability to explain complex offers clearly and co-create solutions with customers.
* Comfortable being the first sales person: you don’t wait for a perfect setup – you build it.
* Strategic enough to think about positioning and pricing, and hands-on enough to pick up the phone, follow up and close deals yourself.
* Motivated more by ownership, impact and learning than by a big corporate package.

**Strongly Preferred**  

* Experience working in or closely with the startup ecosystem (ideally Berlin or Germany-wide), plus a network you can activate.

#### **Why us?**

**Why Join Us?**

* Drive sales at Germany’s Deep Tech Hub: You come in as our first sales hire and close deals from week one, working directly with our Managing Director. Three products with real demand and a leadership team that works alongside you.
* Shape how we sell: We already generate seven-figure revenue; our funnels, pricing and sales collateral are still young. You develop them with us, test what works with real customers and keep what does.
* Sell what you can touch: Your customers build sensors, drones, robots and climate tech on our campuses. You walk them through the labs instead of pitching slides, and you see the startups you signed grow next door.
* Short decision paths, high visibility: You work closely with leadership, and your output directly shapes the success of our startups and corporate partners.
* A culture that is honest, learning-oriented, and community-driven: We celebrate wins, discuss failures openly, and treat feedback as a tool.

**Compensation**  

* Base salary: €52,000–€61,000, depending on experience
* Additional variable: Targets are set jointly each year

**Apply**  
Ready to join us in building the future of deep tech?  
We’d love to hear from you. Apply via the button with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note on why this role is a fit. Questions? Reach out to Fridtjof Gustavs at hiring@motionlab.berlin.

#### **About us**

MotionLab.Berlin is Germany's premier Innovation Hub & Makerspace, an ecosystem for Hardtech, art, creativity, and entrepreneurship. On 5,500 sqm in Berlin-Alt-Treptow we run eight specialist labs, private offices, MakerGarages and event spaces for more than 110 deep tech companies. MotionLab.Berlin is the operating and founding partner of Berlin's official Deep Tech Hub, certified within Germany's national de:hub initiative.  
Three programs cover the full journey: the Tech Talent Program puts students on real industry challenges, the Hardtech Innovation Accelerator takes early-stage founders from idea to product without taking equity, and Deep Tech in Motion opens international markets. Next up: ringberlin, our second campus in Berlin-Tempelhof with 17,000 sqm.  
Working at MotionLab.Berlin means building the place where hardware gets built. You work next to the founders you support, in a hall with a double-decker bus, a CNC lab and a Demo Day stage. Small team, short decisions, real responsibility from day one. English is our working language.  
Questions about a role? Write to hiring@motionlab.berlin, we read every mail. Let's build.

title: Hybrid Customer Service Representative (m/f/d) with Finnish
description:
**Hybrid Customer Service Representative (m/f/d) with Finnish**
===============================================================

**Hybrid Customer Service Representative (m/f/d) with Finnish**
===============================================================

Job-ID: 419757

Berlin, Berlin, DE

Are you looking for an exciting job that offers you both the flexibility of working from home and the dynamism of an office environment? We are looking for motivated and communicative Finnish-speaking **Customer Service Representatives** **(m/f/d)** to support our customer service team for the French-speaking customers of a manufacturer of innovative robotic lawn mowers. If you enjoy working with people, then you've come to the right place!

**Start:** 25.01.2027 | **Location:** Hybrid (Remote + Berlin-Neukölln) | **Weekly hours:** 20 - 40h

  

**Working hours:** Mon - Sat between 08:00 AM and 5:00 PM

  

**Salary:** 2.409,33 - 2.609,33 €/month (Fixed salary 2.409,33 €/month at 40h/week + performance bonus up to 200 €/month)

**Your benefits:**

  

* **Career changers** are very welcome!
* **Variable working environment** thanks to the hybrid model (working in the office and from home)
* **Mentoring and motivation:** Direct support and feedback from colleagues and supervisors
* **Various team events** such as summer parties to create your best Foundever moments as a team
* **Exclusive employee benefits:** Shopping discounts, bike leasing, maximum capital-forming benefits, company pension plan, voucher card with regular top-ups
* **Health and wellness programs:** Global wellness program, our own fitness app, discounts at Wellhub, and much more
* **Internal career opportunities:** 84% of our promotion jobs and 93% of our management positions are filled internally
* **International career opportunities** through worldwide German-speaking projects.
* **27-31 vacation days** (depending on length of service) as well as special leave.
* Optional **German language classes**

**Your new tasks:**

  

* Supporting our Finnish-speaking customer base by phone, email and chat
* Maintaining our customer database and updating all entries
* Offering individual solutions for each call
* Answering customer inquiries about technical questions (installation) or warranty claims

**What you bring with you:**

  

* Fluency in Finnish (C2-level) with very good English
* Excellent customer service expertise
* Previous experience in a customer focused or sales environment, previous contact centre experience is desirable
* Demonstrable experience of working within a structured process
* Proficient IT Skills (Microsoft-Office)
* The ability to work well as part of a team
* Being flexible and open to a new challenge
* Willingness to learn and eagerness to learn
* Empathetic and socially competent personality
* Valid work permit for Germany

Sounds like the right job? **Take your chance and apply now!**

  

**This is what you can expect from us after you have applied:**

**1.** Our super-friendly recruiting team will contact you by phone to introduce themselves to you and clarify all further details.

**2.** After a successful recruitment test, a video interview will take place with your recruiter and a project manager (Team Manager or Operations Manager).

**3.** If all these steps have been completed successfully, we will give you a warm welcome!

  

**You h****ave any further questions?**

Feel free to contact us by e-mail: jobs.germany@foundever.com

**Foundever®** is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +800 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.

  

There are many special moments in life. We also have them in our day-to-day work, because together we achieve great things! *Create your best moments - with Foundever®!*

  

We have a wide variety of people working for us - career changers, students, mothers, fathers, people of different ages, degrees of disability, countries and religions as well as people from the LGBTQIA+ community. **All people are welcome at Foundever®!** Where are you staying?
